exposure: Women who underwent obstetric emergency hysterectomy
cohort: Women who underwent deliveries over a 20-year period (n = 50,526)
finding: Placental factors were the leading cause of obstetric emergency hysterectomy, highlighting the need for preventative measures against placental abnormalities.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery accounted for 11 out of 48 cases (22.9%) of obstetric emergency hysterectomy, while cesarean section accounted for 37 out of 48 cases (77.1%).
